content: Implement the W0122 runtime-owned lifecycle coordinator and neutral memfd/cdev/vfio mirror callback fixture without changing the frozen M0110 descriptors, UAPI, or BAR layout; prove generation/epoch retirement, loss, recovery, idempotence, and pre-commit failure behavior with focused tests.

Content revision 3e89434af6fae4d52b4c7cfdbac20c602fdd1a2d implements the runtime lifecycle coordinator, intermediate mirror stages, candidate high-water reservation, identity-record binding, epoch retirement, request replay/conflict handling, tombstones, and bounded memfd/cdev/vfio-user callbacks. The focused lifecycle test passed; the full dev CTest passed 75/75, including component graph and W0121 model gates.

Content revision f5cdee3e4d8bef41da3d67672057b3fb3fddac3d connects the concrete C++ cdev worker and vfio-user server mirrors to the runtime lifecycle coordinator without changing generated transport records, frozen descriptors, base UAPI, or BAR layout. cdev reset/loss tests passed with retired-generation and DEVICE_LOST completion checks; vfio-user reset advanced generation/epoch and stale DMA map rejection passed. Focused cdev/vfio tests passed 2/2, full dev CTest passed 75/75, component graph passed 17 components/20 edges, and agent records passed. W0122 remains active for memfd integration, QMP/disconnect/restart normalization, provider freeze, failure injection, and qualification.
